findings.statement: Authoritative external retrieval was unavailable; current statutory and supervisory texts were not retrieved.
findings.resolution_reason: Requires a run with authoritative external retrieval capability.

findings.statement: Paragraph-level reconciliation against IDW RS HFA 35 cannot be completed without licensed text.
findings.resolution_reason: Awaiting licensed source access.

findings.statement: All legal conclusions were held at UNESTABLISHED where primary retrieval was unavailable; no exact-correlation claim was made.
findings.resolution_reason: Constraint preserved and reflected in report language.

findings.statement: kcv-validate returned zero deterministic findings after remediation.
findings.resolution_reason: No V-000/V-001/V-003/V-004/V-005/V-006D/V-008/V-024 violations remained.

findings.statement: The issue body was recorded as official-portal retrieval despite external_retrieval = NO.
findings.resolution_reason: Issue #2 is recorded with protocol-valid internal/INTERNAL/internal_source vocabulary, plus an explicit provenance note that it was supplied as task input.

findings.statement: The report listed four use cases but did not separately analyse the required dimensions for each case.
findings.resolution_reason: Section 5 now contains a separate eight-dimension assessment table for each use case, with capability limits preserved.

findings.statement: RenderedSpan records and RENDERED_AT edges were absent, so the affected entailment gates could not legitimately pass.
findings.resolution_reason: G-02, G-04, G-06 and G-07 are now NOT_EVALUATED, and rendered_locations.json is explicitly NOT_PRODUCED in the artifact manifest.

findings.statement: G-15 passed without the protocol-required artifact_manifest.json.
findings.resolution_reason: artifact_manifest.json now records produced and missing artifacts; G-15 is corrected to FAIL until the protocol-minimum split set exists.

findings.statement: The release summary omitted the unresolved blocking production-policy decision.
findings.resolution_reason: D-0001 is now included in both report and release-summary closure actions.

findings.statement: The repository had no distinct schema capable of representing protocol Finding artifacts.
findings.resolution_reason: A separate protocol-finding.schema.json now models the v2.2 object while finding.schema.json remains the deterministic validator contract; tests validate both models.

findings.statement: The expanded case tables contain material working assertions not yet decomposed into atomic Claims and rendered mappings.
findings.resolution_reason: G-13 is now NOT_EVALUATED and the report and release summary explicitly state the remaining mapping work.

findings.statement: The source manifest recorded supplied task-input provenance while the semantic ledger still described the issue as a public internal source.
findings.resolution_reason: Both source views now use protocol-valid internal and INTERNAL values, preserve the supplied-task-input distinction in provenance_note, and are compared by tests.

findings.statement: The manifest did not record every protocol-minimum artifact as produced or omitted.
findings.resolution_reason: Every protocol-minimum artifact name is now represented, and a regression test enforces the complete set.

findings.statement: The review claimed that actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-python@v7 were unpublished and would fail CI.
findings.resolution_reason: Evidence EV-0005 records that GitHub Actions run 32511718595 successfully resolved and executed both v7 actions, directly disproving that the workflow stops before validation. EV-0004 preserves the review thread and supplied release references without treating the referenced release pages as independently verified external evidence. No workflow downgrade was made.

findings.statement: The supplied issue source and its evidence used source and retrieval values outside the protocol vocabulary.
findings.resolution_reason: The records now use internal, INTERNAL and internal_source; provenance_note preserves the supplied-task-input distinction, and new Source/Evidence schemas enforce the protocol vocabulary.

findings.statement: The Finding schema allowed arbitrary remediation_class strings instead of the protocol vocabulary.
findings.resolution_reason: remediation_class is now restricted to AUTO_FIXABLE, AUTO_SOFTENABLE, HUMAN_DECISION and HUMAN_LICENSED_SOURCE.

findings.statement: The evidence behind the rejected action-version finding was linked in the PR thread but not persisted in the run's Source/Evidence records.
findings.resolution_reason: SRC-INT-004/EV-0004 now preserve the review thread and supplied references; SRC-INT-005/EV-0005 preserve the successful GitHub Actions execution. F-254-014 relies on the direct CI evidence and does not overstate independent verification of the named release pages.

findings.statement: The ledger used Claim-scoped EVIDENCED_BY relations from a Finding node that is not part of the semantic ledger graph.
findings.resolution_reason: The invalid Finding-to-Evidence edges were removed. F-254-014 retains explicit EV-0004 and EV-0005 references in resolution_reason, and a regression test requires every EVIDENCED_BY source to be a Claim ID.

findings.statement: The schema constrained remediation_class values but did not require the field for actionable Finding resolutions.
findings.resolution_reason: Conditional schema rules now require remediation_class for ACCEPTED, PARTIAL, OPEN and ESCALATED findings and prohibit it for REJECTED findings; negative regression tests enforce both branches.

findings.statement: The Evidence schema allowed positive retrieval methods without a Source ID and allowed retrieval_method none to claim a Source.
findings.resolution_reason: A conditional schema rule now requires a non-empty source_id for every positive retrieval method and requires source_id null when retrieval_method is none; negative regression tests enforce both directions.

findings.statement: Object-level Evidence validation did not prove that a positive source_id exists in the ledger or agrees with a RETRIEVED_FROM edge.
findings.resolution_reason: A ledger-level regression test now requires every positive Evidence source_id to identify an existing Source and match exactly one RETRIEVED_FROM edge; none-method Evidence must have no such edge.
